Samir — great, that’s exactly the level of detail we need. Based on what you shared, I put together two quick allocation examples and blended unit economics so you can see tradeoffs. See summary below and I’ve attached the full estimate workbook.

Short answer: with a blended target ~$1,100/1M we recommend favoring a quantized mid-tier chat model for the bulk of chat requests, an embeddings-medium model for search, and a lightweight CPU-friendly rerank model for post-processing. That mix preserves response quality while keeping blended cost near your target.

Example A — quality-first (higher cost):
- Chat-large (non-quant) 80% of chat tokens
- Embeddings-large 100% of embeddings tokens
- Rerank-medium 100% of rerank tokens
Estimated blended: ~$1,850 per 1M tokens

Example B — cost-aware (recommended for pilot):
- Chat-medium-quant 70% of chat tokens
- Chat-small-quant 30% of chat tokens (very cheap for short prompts)
- Embeddings-medium 100% of embeddings tokens
- Rerank-light 100% of rerank tokens
Estimated blended: ~$1,050 per 1M tokens

Blended calculation (Example B, simplified):
- Chat: 70M tokens -> cost mix: (70% * $1,200 + 30% * $450) = $930 effective per 1M chat tokens
- Embeddings: 12M -> $600 per 1M embeddings tokens
- Rerank: 3M -> $300 per 1M rerank tokens
Weighted blended across modalities -> ~ $1,050 / 1M tokens

Operational notes:
- If you want Reserved capacity for chat to guarantee latency, we’d recommend sizing initial reserved fleet for 50–60% of average chat volume and routing burst to hosted capacity. That keeps monthly committed spend reasonable while hitting p95 latency targets.
- Caching: autocomplete/prefix caching and KV cache for session history will reduce token consumption by ~10–20% for chat-heavy flows; we can model that if you can share a sample prompt distribution.

I’ve attached: pricing_estimate_Atlas_2026.xlsx (workbook with line-item math) and example_allocation_playbook.pdf (one-pager with suggested rollout).

If the Example B blended estimate looks reasonable, can we lock a 30-min alignment call on Wed 12/2 at 10:00 PT? Ben / Vanessa will join to walk through Sizing vs Reserved cadence.
